reviews.text: Really lovely🤍 Our cat felt at ease and relaxed during the appointment

Kattenkliniek Sarphatipark is the best vet I’ve ever experienced. Both my cats are well cared for and made to feel calm and relaxed in their time there. One of my cats has a longterm health condition and regularly receives extra checks via telephone calls and appointments. They are accommodating and do everything possible to make sure that both owners and felines are made to feel comfortable.

I took my 19-year-old cat to Tess to have his nails trimmed. It was the first time he was without sedation, and all his nails were trimmed without any problems. I was really worried about my big cat, but Tess put him wonderfully at ease! Thank you so much, Tess! You were fantastic!!!

Our cats received exceptional care at the cat clinic from Marina Gomes. This is exactly what you look for in a veterinarian; she talks to your animal with so much humor and love, is highly skilled, and passionate about cats. She reads them so well! Truly different from a veterinarian, who are sometimes really more dog people. It is a bit of a drive from the west, but it is completely worth it; we love coming back here with our furry friends.

We have been coming to the Kattenkliniek with Suki since she was a kitten, and we are very happy with the care she receives. The team is always helpful, thoughtful and willing to think along with you.

Their love and passion for cats is truly noticeable. They do everything they can to make each visit as comfortable as possible, with lots of patience and attention (and liquid snacks). Thanks to their gentle approach, Suki is always calm and even curious during her visits.

We are grateful for the care and dedication of the whole team!
Love this clinic 🫶🏼🐱 …
Very happy with this cat clinic. It was the first visit. Received such a warm welcome, plus a wonderful and very sweet vet.

My Paquito is a patient here and every time we have to take him for check up or any other appointment, he is always happy, the staff is very friendly and always treat him so nicely. If you have a cat don’t hesitate in bringing it here! :)

I wish every vet was like Dr. Mariana Gomes. She has that rare combination of being incredibly knowledgeable while also making you feel truly heard.

She was the first person to put all the pieces together in a complex kidney case instead of looking at each test in isolation. Every recommendation was thoughtful, evidence-based, and explained in a way that made me feel confident rather than overwhelmed.

She also helped me navigate the health requirements for moving internationally with my two cats, and her guidance made the whole process far less stressful.

I’m incredibly grateful for her care and wouldn’t hesitate to trust her again. She’s an outstanding veterinarian, and both Kattenkliniek Sarphatipark and Kattenkliniek Vondelpark are very lucky to have her.
Thank you :)!
The veterinarian is very competent. An examination is performed only when it is truly useful. The staff are friendly and understand the customer's needs.
Thank you!
Thanks Jasper!

The best veterinary clinic for cats you can find in Amsterdam. After a lot of searching, I decided to go to this cats-only clinic, and it was absolutely worth it. The staff are friendly and very professional, and the entire space is designed specifically for cats, which helps them feel much calmer during the visit.
We are so incredibly happy with the excellent care provided by the entire team. They are very knowledgeable, kind, and thoughtful. Rosie feels at ease, which makes a visit feel relaxing.

The best veterinary clinic in Amsterdam! They focus exclusively on cats and don’t treat other animals. The clinic uses Feliway diffusers, and cats are incredibly relaxed there. (Her body temperature is even 0.8°C lower here compared to other clinics when being examined because she doesn’t feel nervous!) She’s not frightened by barking dogs or the smell of other animals.

The vet is wonderful (I recorded her name in the picture), and the reception staff is extremely friendly. The entire visit is completely cat-centered. Even shy or nervous cats are given time to slowly adapt and feel comfortable.

I also highly recommend their Happy Pet Plan. It’s truly very useful. There’s no waiting period, it’s convenient, and very cost-effective. Every interaction, whether over the phone or in person, has been absolutely satisfying.

I strongly recommend this clinic to every cat owner looking for a vet. I’m so happy with them that this review might be getting a bit long, haha!
Nice place,very friendly employees and profesional in them work.
Super sweet welcome!

nice and clean place, the personnel are attentive.

I have never felt so comfortable at a vet previously and am sure our cats would also agree.
I personally love the vibe of the clinic as well as their marketing, makes every Amsterdam girl in their 20s want to bring their kitties over !
Thank you :)!

This is definitely the best vet for your cat in the city.  It might be the best cat vet in the world.  You will be VERY happy you brought your furry friends here.

A wonderful clinic specializing in the treatment and health of cats. Super friendly team, expert veterinarians. Very different from the veterinary practices that are unfortunately being taken over by investors these days. Here, you still receive personal treatment for both humans and animals.
Thank you :)!
Amazing doctors and staff. Professional, taking their time and explaining everything carefully. You can feel the passion in the whole clinic.
Thanks Geraldine :)!
Great place to bring your cat! No other animals so your cat will be less stressed.

After not having a good experience with my previous vet, I started looking for a clinic specifically for cats. They take plenty of time, which is incredibly nice for both cat and owner! All the staff are very friendly, and the practice is modern, clean, and quiet. This will definitely be our new regular vet! :)
Best place for my anxious cat! He gets space to calm down. Highly recommended.
It's great to meet a veterinarian who is absolutely passionate about her profession and is also crazy about cats!

I took my cat Muffin for the first time today. He was very nervous, but I'm so glad I found this clinic. They gave Muffin a wonderful consultation and checked him over everything. The doctor (Mariana) calmed him down almost immediately, making him feel comfortable. Mariska at the reception desk also made us feel welcome.

We had a very pleasant experience at the clinic last week! The place is very quiet and clean, and the staff were really sweet to my cat. The doctor took his time to discuss the issues and treatment plan, and answered all of my questions. Would definitely recommend :)

Amazing! We brought our two cats, and they stayed with one of the cat while the other one was visited, they called to check on our cats after the operations, they take the time to explain.

5 stars because, but I would have preferred to give 6. Very happy that I switched to this clinic. Good communication and they take really excellent care of the animals. They are super relaxed there. So my only concern is that they wouldn't want to go home after a visit ;)

What a breath of fresh air this clinic is. The calm that prevails, the time taken, the expertise and patience of the doctors and assistants… truly wonderful. And of course, the care, love, and gentleness with which the cats are treated. It is not for nothing that this clinic has the ‘cat-friendly’ designation (Cat Friendly certificate from the ISFM). Additionally, it is also very ‘owner-friendly’ 😸 Highly recommended!

I fully agree with all the other positive reviews. Our cat has recently been receiving treatment at this clinic, and we couldn't have wished for a better place. From start to finish, the care and friendliness of the staff are truly exceptional. The way you are welcomed, both you and your cat, exceeds all expectations—it really feels like a warm embrace.

The team is not only professional but also genuinely committed to your pet's well-being. They take the time to explain everything calmly and listen carefully to our concerns. Our cat, who is normally quite shy, felt wonderfully at ease here.

In short, this clinic deserves all praise, and I can wholeheartedly recommend it to any pet owner looking for expert and loving care.

An incredibly beautiful and lovely clinic. Specially set up “only” for cats!!! How cool is that!? 😻 The assistants and veterinarians really do have a heart for all animals, and surely a little extra for our cats 🥰 …

Knowledgeable, kind, personal, and thoughtful!

After having seen quite a few veterinarians, I can only have more praise for this practice.

Honest advice on what is truly best for the cat in question, and genuine interest in the animal and how he is doing.

A clinic you can trust and are happy to visit (when, unfortunately, it has to be done).

If you have doubts about your veterinarian, come here, and you won't want to go anywhere else.

This clinic is extremely friendly, and from the first appointment, I got a strong sense that it’s a cat-first organisation, whose aim is to make life for unwell cats as tolerable as possible. The vets and nurses here are very conscientious …

Veterinarian Mariana Gomez is amazing! She helped our cat Bobbie fantastically. Loving, decisive, and dedicated. Wonderful! Thanks again Mariana and the entire team, you get a 10+ from us.
